messages:
olivia_cs: Hi team — Aurora onboarding: they just returned the vendor security questionnaire and flagged a couple of blockers for go-live. attaching: https://files.redwood.co/aurora/qna-answers.pdf

sam_security: on it. quick win first — do we have SOC2 evidence they asked for (subservice org, scoping)?

jordan_engineering: we have the most recent SOC2 report in GDrive (shared to cs@). caveat: the report lists third-party datastore under limited scope — they asked about encryption in transit+at-rest and KMS rotation cadence.

olivia_cs: copy. Aurora needs explicit KMS rotation schedule and whether keys are customer-managed. they want to confirm no PII is persisted from streaming ingestion.

li_onboarding: for product onboarding: Aurora plans 50k monthly active users in Q2. renewal risk flagged if we don't show isolation controls and a Data Processing Addendum. they asked for a signed DPA and a simple data flow diagram.

sam_security: quick answers: 1) encryption in transit — TLS 1.2+ (we can provide excerpt). 2) at-rest — AES-256, default managed keys; we support BYOK via KMS integration (customer-managed keys) — need to confirm if Aurora will use our KMS or bring their own. 3) rotation cadence — 90 days recommended for customer-managed, internal rotation varies by cluster type.

jordan_engineering: technically: no logs contain raw PII by default, we redact known PII in ingestion pipelines and prefix-cache is ephemeral per-request. I can paste the config snippet:```
logging.redaction.enabled=true
redaction.rules=ssn,email,phone
````

sam_security: please add that snippet to the questionnaire answer. also attach the SOC2 cover page + index. I'll draft the DPA language for CS/legal to sign off.

olivia_cs: amazing, @sam_security @jordan_engineering — can you both drop the final artifacts by EOD? Aurora is asking to close this week to keep the onboarding schedule.

jordan_engineering: will do. I'll upload a short data flow diagram (SVG) and the config snippet.

sec-bot: Reminder — security-review slot available tomorrow 10:30-11:00. Use /reserve to claim.

li_onboarding: I'll book the slot and invite Aurora (they asked for a short walkthrough of where data lives).

sam_security: drafted DPA Qs and answers in the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.co/sec/dpa-aurora-draft — please comment.

olivia_cs: adding CS checklist items: 1) send DPA draft to Aurora legal 2) send SOC2 excerpt + data flow 3) schedule walkthrough 4) confirm KMS plan — update enablement deck to include residency notes.

olivia_cs: FYI — Aurora also left feedback: wants clearer runbook for incident notifications and SLA escalation path. can we include a one-page SLA escalation addendum?

sam_security: yes. I can produce a 1-page incident notif + escalation path template.

jordan_engineering: small ask — if Aurora brings BYOK, routing needs a config flag; ops needs to know before prod cutover. I'll add that to the engineering rollout checklist.

olivia_cs: thanks everyone — next steps: jordan + sam upload artifacts by EOD, li books review slot, I’ll send the DPA to their counsel after security signs off. tagging for visibility: @jordan_engineering @sam_security :thumbsup:

li_onboarding: booked 2024-06-12 10:30 PT with Aurora. invite sent.

olivia_cs: great — marking this thread for follow-up. will post final attachments here once we have sign-off. :sparkles:
